subject: [PATCH 24/60] mm/madvise: restrict reclaim advice to common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts MADV_COLD, MADV_PAGEOUT, and MADV_FREE to common memory by converting ZONE_DEVICE checks in madvise_free_huge_pmd() and related functions to folio_is_common_memory(). This change aims to prevent these operations from affecting device memory.
